subject: OneMedford Day Krystle Campbell Tribute
overview: Medford High School students and community members honored Boston Marathon victim Krystle Campbell and shared personal commitments for OneMedford Day.

items.title: OneMedford Day Tributes and Community Commitments
items.summary: Participants reflected on the legacy of Medford High alumna Krystle Campbell, supported her scholarship fund, and shared actions they are taking to strengthen the Medford community.
